salesCopy.description:

This isn't another note-taking tutorial or productivity hack. It's a complete blueprint for building a Personal Knowledge Management system using systems-first thinking and tool-agnostic principles that work anywhere.

At its core, this course is about turning chaos into order, complexity into simplicity, and information into actionable knowledge. You'll learn a clear, proven process that takes you from information overload to systematic knowledge building. Native AI integration (`ChatGPT`, `Claude`, `DeepSeek`, `Gemini`, `NotebookLM`, `MCP`) that others simply don't cover.

Join **200+ professionals** who have transformed their workflows with this system.

originStory.title: The Breaking Point
originStory.subtitle: Why I Built This Course
originStory.story:
For years, I lived with constant frustration. 'Where did I see this? Where did I put that? What app did I use for that?' I had information scattered across dozens of tools, documents, and browser tabs. No consistency. No system. Just chaos.

I'd read something brilliant, take a note... and never find it again when I actually needed it. Important ideas slipped through my fingers daily. The mental load of trying to remember everything was crushing my ability to think clearly and create.

After years of trial and error, learning from experts, and gradual refinement, I finally cracked the code. I built a system that actually works. One that's been battle-tested through years of real-world use, not just theory from a book.

This course contains everything I wish I had known from the start. The principles that took me years to discover, synthesized into a clear, actionable blueprint.

creatorJourney.title: **20+ Years** in the Making
creatorJourney.subtitle: From Information Chaos to Systems Mastery
creatorJourney.story:
My journey with knowledge management spans over **two decades** of working in IT and software development. I've worn many hats: Software Developer, Technical Lead, Software Architect, Solution Architect, Infrastructure Architect. Through it all, I've been obsessed with one question: how do we organize and leverage what we know?

I've explored countless systems, learned from the best minds in the field, and gradually refined my approach through daily practice. This isn't theory from a book. It's my actual system, the one I use every single day to manage a complex business, create content, coach clients, and maintain a knowledge base of over **10,000 notes**.

Now, as a Knowledge Management coach who has helped **hundreds of professionals**, I've distilled everything I've learned into this course. The principles that took me years to discover are now available to you in a clear, actionable format.
struggles: Information scattered across dozens of apps and documents
Brilliant ideas lost because I couldn't find them when I needed them
The mental exhaustion of trying to remember everything
Abandoned system after system that just didn't stick
achievements: Built a **10,000+ note** knowledge base that I actually use daily
Created the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit), used by over **a thousand professionals**
Authored **multiple courses and books** on PKM and productivity
creatorJourney.credentials: **20+ years** in IT and software development. Knowledge Management coach. Author of multiple courses on PKM and `Obsidian`. Creator of the [Obsidian Starter Kit](/product/obsidian-starter-kit). Daily practitioner with a **10,000+ note** knowledge base.
